name: Flavia Moser
headline: GenAI Product Manager at SAP
summary:
Hello, I’m Flavia Moser and I’m dedicated to data and its transformative potential. I am thriving in my current role as a Product Manager specializing in Analytics and generative AI. Each day, I have the privilege of sharing this commitment with both customers and colleagues, cultivating meaningful insights that drive innovation and elevate outcomes.

Engaging Presenter | Collaborator:
My journey is marked by a distinct ability to translate complex concepts into captivating narratives. As an
accomplished presenter and effective communicator, I've had the honor of taking the stage at international conferences and webinars, delivering enlightening sessions that resonate with audiences. 

Holistic Strategist | Innovator:
Collaborating with (executive) stakeholders from diverse domains - development, user experience, marketing, sales, and presales - embodies my holistic approach to shaping a data-driven strategies. I thrive in the dynamic interplay of ideas, fusing Design Thinking with strategic foresight to sculpt effective roadmaps.

Data Science Trailblazer:
As a trailblazer in Data Science, I laid the foundation long before it became a buzzword. Holding a Ph.D. in Data Mining, I've diligently honed my expertise through impactful engagements at industry giants like SAP and Microsoft, as well as the esteemed research institution BC Centre for Disease Control. My
accomplishments are highlighted by co-innovation on five granted and three in-progress patents, each harnessed by released features that have transformed the Analytic landscape.

Let's connect and explore how our shared passion for data can shape the future of innovation.

positions.title: GenAI Product Manager
positions.description: Product Manager specializing in Analytics and Generative AI, responsible for defining product strategy, prioritizing features, and guiding cross-functional teams through development cycles. Successfully released two GenAI features, see blogs below.

positions.title: Lead Product Expert
positions.description:
I am Lead Product Expert (leading a virtual team of product experts) of the "smart feature" portfolio within SAP Analytics Cloud. The smart features are Machine Learning powered features that enable business users to automatically gain insights into their data. In my role, I work with customers to understand their business needs and translate into innovative, easy to use features. 

You can find one of our recently released features, Search to Insight, here: https://www.sapanalytics.cloud/search-to-insights-use-case/

positions.title: Product Expert
positions.description:
I am the Chief Product Expert for the Smart Assist portfolio in SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), SAP's SaaS offering in the Analytics space. In my role, I am driving Machine Learning-based innovations for Business Users, including the recently released features showcased in links below. My responsibilities  include: 
- roadmap definition
- feature requirements
- internal and external enablement

positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description: I am leading the predictive Product Management team for Americas. Our goal is to enable customers in the area of SAP BusinessObjects Predictive Analytics, SAP HCP predictive services and SAP BusinessObjects Cloud.

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description:
As a Data Scientist, I was in the development organization in various capacities: 
- As a product expert / product owner, I worked closely with the development team defining new features in SAP Lumira
- As a trainer, I created and offered internal training
- As a data scientist, I developed new methods in the area of SmartBI, which resulted in four patent applications. Some of these ideas have been productized.

positions.title: Senior Scientist
positions.description: • Internal promotion: from 'Postdoctoral Intern' to 'Research Scientist' to 'Senior Scientist'

company.description:
SAP is a global leader in enterprise applications and business AI, helping organizations run end-to-end operations on a unified cloud ERP platform.
With SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP Business AI, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP enables companies to connect data, automate processes, and make real-time, intelligent decisions across the enterprise.
SAP capabilities and portfolio
•	Cloud ERP: SAP S/4HANA Cloud (finance, procurement, core operations) 
•	Business AI: Embedded AI across HR, finance, supply chain, and customer experience 
•	Data & Integration: SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) data, analytics, and application development 
•	Human Resources: SAP SuccessFactors (workforce management and employee experience) 
•	Customer Experience: SAP CX (commerce, marketing, sales, and service) 
•	Supply Chain: SAP SCM (planning, logistics, manufacturing, operations) 
•	Enterprise integration: Connect SAP and non-SAP systems across the business 
•	Real-time insights: Operational data, analytics, and predictive capabilities 
•	Automation: Intelligent workflows embedded directly into business processes 

SAP combines cloud ERP, data, and AI to help organizations operate more efficiently, adapt faster, and grow in an AI-driven world, supported by a global ecosystem of customers and partners.
